name: Knee push-up
summary: From the knees, body straight from head to knee, lower the chest to the floor and press up.
setup: Kneel side-on to the phone at floor level, hands under the shoulders, hips forward so the body is one line from shoulder to knee. Lower the chest toward the floor and press up.
brief: Hands under the shoulders, hips forward so the body is one line from shoulder to knee. Lower the chest toward the floor and press up.
why: From the side the elbow angle closes and opens each rep, so reps are counted.

faults.label: Not reaching the target
faults.tip: Take each rep through the full range you set — half reps count as partials.

faults.label: Too fast
faults.tip: Control both directions; momentum takes the work away from the muscle.

faults.label: Hips bending
faults.tip: Push the hips forward so the line from shoulder to knee is straight; do not sit back.

faults.label: Hips piking up
faults.tip: The line runs from knees to head, not hips to head. Push the hips forward a little.

faults.label: Cutting depth
faults.tip: Lower until the chest nearly touches.

faults.label: Knees hurting on the floor
faults.cue: Fold a mat under the knees
faults.tip: Padding under the knees is not cheating.
